summary.text: Rebecca Dow is a Republican state representative from District 38 who served from 2017 to 2023, returned to the seat in January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She sought the Republican nomination for governor in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca Dow, born in 1973, earned an associate's degree from Tulsa Community College and a Bachelor of Science degree in business management from Oral Roberts University.
She first represented the 38th district from January 2017 to January 2023, and began her current stint in office on January 1, 2025.
Dow was an unsuccessful candidate for the Republican nomination in the 2022 New Mexico gubernatorial election, finishing second in the primary with 15.47 percent of the vote, behind Mark Ronchetti.
